QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Exploration Captain, Athena Pierce
QuestInfo.0: Ask Athena Pierce about the current situation.
QuestInfo.1: You were able to learn about the situaion in Ellin Forest from Athena Pierce. She asked you to go help #e#bPerzen#k#n, the magician who created a Barrier Stone to protect Altaire Camp.
QuestInfo.2: You met Perzen on the right side of Altaire Camp.

0.0: I cannot tell you what changes you, a traveler from another world, could make to our future, but we cannot concern ourselves with that.\r\n#L0##bSo, what period am I in? Is this Ellinia of the past?#l\n#k
0.1: Ellinia? Is that what this place is called in the future? I cannot say. While Aran and the heroes fought against the Black Mage, I and a few remaining survivors took an airship and headed to Victoria Island. However, we were attacked by dragons en route, and crashed in this forest. I really know nothing more of this place...\r\n#L0##bWait, Aran and the heroes fought the Black Mage? Recently? Then...what happened?#l\n#k
0.2: According to Perzen, they succeeded in sealing the Black Mage.\r\n#L0##bOh. Where I come from...#l\n#k
0.3: Stop! Your world is our future. Knowing our future might change things for the worse... Right now, we need people to help explore and develop this place. Would you be willing to help us?

yes.0: Thank you. Most of the young people are working outside of the camp, so Perzen is working on his Barrier Stone alone. Please see if he needs help.

no.0: I see. Return if you are inclined to help.

1.0: Athena Pierce sent you, yes? I have been waiting for you.

npc.0: You can find Perzen next to the Barrier Stone on the right side of Altaire Camp.
